'''2009 Worlds Day 2 James Booker LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
